name: pager
title: Pager
description: The page before and the page after, at the foot of an article.
use: Pages read in an order: a guide, a course, the chapters of a document. Each link says which it is with rel="prev" or rel="next"; the stylesheet reads that to place it and to point its arrow. Leave out the link that does not exist: the first page has only a next.

instead.when: The pages are numbered pages of one long list
The reader needs to see where the page is in the site
It is a short sequence with the current step marked

classes.name: pager
classes.description: The two links side by side, on a nav with an accessible name; in a container under 26rem they stack

classes.name: pager-link
classes.description: One link, with rel="prev" or rel="next": a flat face that rises a step under the pointer. The next page stands at the end with its words set to the end

classes.name: pager-label
classes.description: The quiet word over the title, Previous or Next, with an arrow that points the way the link goes

classes.name: pager-title
classes.description: The title of the page the link leads to

states.name: next
states.description: The link to the page after: it stands at the end, and its arrow follows the word and points forward

example: PreviousInstallation NextTheming
